name: Hard Shell Jacket (GORE-TEX Pro 3-Layer)
description: Fully taped seams, helmet-compatible hood, pit zips for ventilation during steep uphill skinning or climbing.

name: 800+ Fill Power Down Expedition Parka
description: Box-wall baffle construction with water-resistant down for sub-zero summit pushes and windy ridge bivouacs.

name: Mid-Layer Polartec Grid Fleece / Active Synthetic
description: Breathable moisture-wicking layer providing active warmth during rigorous ascents.

name: Merino Wool Thermal Base Layer (Top & Bottom)
description: Natural odor resistance, superior thermoregulation even when damp from exertion.

name: Double Mountaineering Boots (B3 Rated)
description: Rigid vibram sole for front-pointing with insulated removable inner bootie preventing frostbite up to 6,500m.

name: Steel 12-Point Crampons with Anti-Balling Plates
description: Step-in automatic wire bails fitted precisely to B3 boot welts; latex anti-snow plates prevent lethal snow clogging.

name: Glacier High-Gaiters (Breathable Cordura)
description: Protects against deep post-holing in wet snow and guards calves against sharp crampon point tears.

name: Satellite Two-Way Communicator (Garmin inReach)
description: Global Iridium satellite SOS capability with 100% pole-to-pole coverage, tracking breadcrumbs, and two-way SMS.

name: High-Precision Altimeter Barometer Compass (ABC Watch)
description: Tracks sudden barometric drops signaling incoming storm fronts; recalibrate daily at known elevation markers.

name: Waterproof Topographic Maps (1:25,000 / 1:50,000) & Compass
description: Fail-safe analog navigation when extreme sub-zero cold kills lithium-ion batteries.

name: 4-Season Expedition Sleeping Bag (-20°C to -35°C Rating)
description: Hydrophobic goose down with water-repellent Pertex shell; integrated hood and draft collar.

name: Dual Sleeping Pad System (Inflatable R-Value > 4.5 + Closed-Cell Foam)
description: Prevents conductive heat loss to frozen glacier ice; closed-cell foam acts as insurance against punctures.

name: White Gas / Multi-Fuel Stove with Windscreen
description: Burns kerosene, white gas, or unleaded fuel efficiently at high altitudes and sub-zero temperatures where canister gas fails.

name: Mountaineering Ice Axe (Classic Curved Pick)
description: T-rated steel pick for self-arrest and step cutting; adze for chopping bucket seats in hard firn.

name: Climbing Harness with Adjustable Leg Loops
description: Fits easily over bulky down pants; dedicated ice clipper slots and reinforced tie-in points.

name: CE Certified Mountaineering Helmet
description: Protects against falling rock, ice chunks, and head impact during slip-and-fall incidents.

name: Glacier Travel Kit (Crevasse Rescue Ropes, Prusiks, Pulleys, Ice Screws)
description: Two 6mm prusik loops, Tibloc/Micro Traxion, 120cm Dyneema sling, 2 screwgate carabiners, 19cm ice screw.

name: Insulated 1-Liter Wide-Mouth Water Bottles with Parka Sleeves
description: Nalgene bottles stored inside thermal foam sleeves; wide mouth prevents mouth opening from freezing shut.

name: High-Calorie Electrolyte Tablets & Energy Gels
description: Combats altitude dehydration and replaces sodium, potassium, and magnesium lost through rapid breathing.

name: Glacier Sunglasses (Category 4 Protection with Side Shields)
description: Transmits only 3-8% visible light; blocks 100% harmful UV rays to prevent devastating snow blindness.

name: High-Altitude Medical Kit (Diamox, Dexamethasone, Nifedipine, Painkillers)
description: Prescription altitude medication carried in accessible pack pocket with dosage chart.
